# X Downloader

A free and fast tool to download high-quality videos and images from X (Twitter).

## Features
- Download original quality videos and images
- Built-in AI translation for tweets
- No watermark
- Search history caching

## Links
- [Trang chủ](https://x.enmixx.com/)
- [Mã nguồn GitHub](https://github.com/yngpiu/x-downloader)
